title: Multi-omics integrative analysis elucidates the molecular characteristics of SMARCA4-deficient lung adenocarcinoma and the derived therapeutic options.
authors: Guo, Deyu; Wang, Kai; Sun, Shijie; Chi, Yuxiang; Du, Jiajun; Dong, Wei
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学整合与机器学习分析SMARCA4缺陷型肺腺癌的分子特征和治疗选项，虽涉及机器学习但核心是肿瘤临床与代谢表型，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: SMARCA4-deficient lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is highly aggressive with multiple oncogene mutations, and has low sensitivity to chemotherapy, targeted therapy and immunotherapy. By integrating multi-omics analysis and machine learning analysis on 20 lung adenocarcinoma datasets, we characterized SMARCA4 mutation in clinical prognosis, metabolic level, immune infiltration and pathway enrichment. The key role of SMARCA4 in LUAD development was confirmed by several in vitro and in vivo experiments. SMARCA4 is highly expressed in LUAD tissues compared with adjacent tissues, and SMARCA4 mutation is a poor prognostic factor. Although SMARCA4-deficient LUAD patients are not sensitive to common chemotherapeutic drugs, immunotherapy is an alternative treatment for lung adenocarcinoma. SMARCA4 deletion is associated with a high rate of oncogene co-mutation. Co-mutation of KRAS was found to have a significant impact on the response to multiple types of chemotherapy. Unique metabolic profiles, abnormal cell cycle and hyperactivation of oxidative phosphorylation were hallmarks of SMARCA4 mutant LUAD. We screened four chemotherapeutic agents targeting MTOR pathway, oxidative stress, DNA replication or cell cycle, including rapamycin and ribociclib, as potential chemotherapeutic agents for SMARCA4-deficient lung adenocarcinoma. In vitro assays showed that SMARCA4 knockdown significantly inhibited DNA replication, cell cycle and cell proliferation in lung adenocarcinoma cells, and significantly promoted oxidative stress and apoptosis in lung adenocarcinoma cells. Our comprehensive findings advance our understanding of SMARCA4 mutant LUAD gene mutation and immune microenvironment, providing insights into potential therapeutic approaches and research directions for SMARCA4-deficient LUAD.
abstract_zh: SMARCA4缺陷型肺腺癌（LUAD）具有高度侵袭性，伴随多种致癌基因突变，并对化疗、靶向治疗和免疫治疗敏感性较低。通过对20个肺腺癌数据集整合多组学分析和机器学习分析，我们表征了SMARCA4突变在临床预后、代谢水平、免疫浸润及通路富集方面的特征。通过多项体外和体内实验，确认了SMARCA4在LUAD发展中的关键作用。与癌旁组织相比，SMARCA4在LUAD组织中高表达，且SMARCA4突变是预后不良的因素。尽管SMARCA4缺陷型LUAD患者对常见化疗药物不敏感，但免疫治疗是肺腺癌的一种替代治疗方案。SMARCA4缺失与高频率的致癌基因共突变相关。发现KRAS共突变对多种类型化疗的反应有显著影响。独特的代谢谱、异常细胞周期及氧化磷酸化过度激活是SMARCA4突变型LUAD的标志。我们筛选了四种靶向MTOR通路、氧化应激、DNA复制或细胞周期的化疗药物，包括雷帕霉素和瑞博西尼，作为SMARCA4缺陷型肺腺癌的潜在化疗药物。体外实验显示，SMARCA4敲低显著抑制了肺腺癌细胞的DNA复制、细胞周期和细胞增殖，并显著促进了肺腺癌细胞的氧化应激和凋亡。我们的综合发现加深了对SMARCA4突变型LUAD基因突变和免疫微环境的理解，为SMARCA4缺陷型LUAD的潜在治疗方法和研究方向提供了见解。
